remarks: Welcome to 'The Courtyard' built by Buildwise Homes which features a triple garage, located in Windermere North, close to shopping, restaurants & schools. Grand foyer is open to above, features 20 ft ceiling, arch designs & arched stairs. Main floor has coffered ceiling design & features  designer kitchen with Taj Mahal countertops & backspalsh, shaker style cabinets, gas stove, butler's pantry, 2 fridges, built in appliances & great sized island. Dining area is equipped with built in bar and cozy living room features Napolean Altitude X gas fireplace. A den, full bath & a pet wash finish off the main floor. Upstairs, you will find oversized primary suite with vaulted ceiling, grand walk in closet & 5 pc designer ensuite. 3 secondary bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a living room & laundry complete 2nd floor. House has herringbone flooring, covered deck with balcony on top, 10 ft ceiling on main, 9 ft ceiling on 2nd floor, 8ft designer doors & 2 furnaces. House is in drywall stage, buyer can choose colour scheme. (id:67522)
